[P3] Reject or correctly convert fractional-minute bounds

Both regexes accept `2026-10-23T18:42.5Z`. With seconds omitted, the parser defaults them to `00` and interprets the fraction as seconds, producing `18:42:00.500Z`. The ISO-8601 fractional-minute value denotes `18:42:30Z`, so normalization silently moves the requested boundary by 29.5 seconds. Require explicit seconds whenever a fraction is supplied, or implement fractional-minute conversion, and cover this input in the normalization tests.
